sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def gpos():
    nodes=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']; out=[]
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color']=='N':
            pts=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
            ch=[nodes[c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs),n['pixels'],ch))
    return sorted(out)
print('start', gpos())
action(['UP']);   print('UP',   gpos())
action(['DOWN']); print('DOWN', gpos())
action(['LEFT']); print('LEFT', gpos())
action(['RIGHT']);print('RIGHT',gpos())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
